svg.title: AgentPlaza: your AI agents, governed
svg.desc: AgentPlaza keeps each agent in its own microVM with no network, checks every tool call against your laws, and pays from a budget you control.
svg.text: Open source · Linux · macOS · Windows · Raspberry Pi
Each agent sealed in its own microVM, held to laws you write and paid from
every tool call is checked against the laws before it runs
